sources.title: Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct official checkpoint card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact instruction-tuned vision checkpoint card still reports the smaller Llama 3.2 Vision model as 11B (10.6). This is Meta's nominal complete-model specification, not an active-count disclosure. The public card was accessed; no gated checkpoint files were needed for this pass.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Vision model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026: the vision card covers pretrained and instruction-tuned models and reports 11B (10.6), text/image input, text output and cross-attention adaptation of Llama 3.1. It does not give a separate active count.

sources.title: Llama 3.2: Revolutionizing edge AI and vision with open, customizable models
sources.evidence: September 25, 2024 announcement releases pretrained and instruction-tuned 11B/90B vision models for download. Describes an image encoder and trained cross-attention adapter added to a pretrained Llama 3.1 language model.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Custom license for Llama 3.2 materials, dated September 25, 2024; permits limited use, modification and redistribution, incorporates the Acceptable Use Policy, and adds separate terms above 700 million monthly active users.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Acceptable Use Policy
sources.evidence: Multimodal rights under Section 1(a) are not granted to individuals domiciled in the EU or companies with a principal place of business there. This restriction excludes end users of incorporating products or services.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 vision prompt format
sources.evidence: Documents vision-model conversations and native built-in/zero-shot tool calls with text-only prompts. Explicitly says tool calling does not work with images in the prompt. Describes cross-attention rather than early fusion; no dedicated thinking mode is specified.

sources.title: Official model SKU definitions: Llama3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct SKU maps to the assigned HF checkpoint and specifies 32 language layers, width 4096, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, and 8 vision cross-attention layers. This is the default BF16 SKU, not a text-only or quantized sibling.

sources.title: Official model families and maximum sequence lengths
sources.evidence: Maps the exact 11B Vision Instruct ID to Llama 3.2 and multimodal status. max_seq_length returns 131072 for non-int4 Llama 3.2 models, including this default BF16 checkpoint.

sources.title: Official cross-attention multimodal Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026: dense multimodal implementation skips the vision encoder when no images are supplied, constructs and reuses cross-attention KV caches, and bypasses cross-attention blocks when text_only_inference is true. It supports the qualification that a published nominal active convention is not an exact phase- or token-level participation measurement.

sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report, Table 3: active parameters of comparison VLMs
sources.evidence: Table 3 explicitly identifies Llama3.2-11B-Inst. and lists 8B+2.6B under # Act. Params (LLM+VT), totaling nominal 10.6B; its separate total row is 11B. This is the original research team's multimodal comparison convention, not Meta disclosure. The April v1 and June v3 table agree. The instruction-tuned 11B multimodal identity is unambiguous; the table does not provide checkpoint revision, per-token accounting or a separate encoder/adapter split.

sources.title: Meta Llama versioning, updates and migration
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 check: current official documentation retains Llama 3.2 sizes 1B, 3B, 11B and 90B. It gives explicit active counts for Llama 4 but no separate active specification for Llama 3.2 Vision.

sources.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models, multimodal architecture section
sources.evidence: Fresh paper-cache review: section 7.2 describes an 850M image encoder and about 100B cross-attention parameters for a 405B-language-model prototype; the introduction calls these multimodal models unreleased research. These prototype component counts do not establish counts for the released Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct model and were not transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: Kimi-VL Table 3 explicitly lists Llama3.2-11B-Inst. at 8B+2.6B active parameters (LLM+VT), summing to nominal 10.6B. Attribute this multimodal comparison convention to the Kimi team, not Meta. It does not establish exact participation for every decode token or text-only input; Meta's implementation skips/caches vision work. No separate phase count or encoder-only component count is inferred.

architecture.note: Verified from official implementation: dense Transformer language backbone and vision encoder, connected by eight gated cross-attention blocks. No routed experts; the scalar cross-attention gates are not MoE routing.

context_window.note: The exact BF16 Vision Instruct SKU belongs to the non-int4 Llama 3.2 branch whose maximum sequence length is 131072; resolves the model card 128k notation.

modalities.note: Official vision card specifies text and image input, with text output.

reasoning.note: Image reasoning is a documented capability, but the inspected card and vision prompt protocol do not disclose a separate thinking/reasoning mode. Clear the unsupported categorical false rather than conflate task reasoning with a dedicated mode.

tool_call.note: The vision-specific official protocol documents native tool calls for text-only inputs. It explicitly excludes tool calling when the prompt contains images.

patch.notes: Meta reports nominal 10.6B total (11B label). Nominal 10.6B active follows the Kimi team's explicit 8B+2.6B LLM+VT convention in Kimi-VL Table 3; it is not a Meta active-count disclosure or an exact per-token measurement. Dense language and vision Transformers use eight cross-attention adapter blocks. Native tool calling is documented only for text-only prompts, not prompts containing images. A dedicated thinking mode is undisclosed. The Llama 3.2 license incorporates multimodal EU restrictions, with an exception for end users of incorporating products or services. The official 128k context is 131072 tokens.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit preserves Meta's nominal 10.6B complete-model total and resolves active parameters to nominal 10.6B using Kimi-VL Table 3's explicit 8B+2.6B LLM+VT comparison convention. Checked the April v1 and June v3 report, original Meta checkpoint/card/launch/code, current migration documentation and the earlier Llama 3 paper. Exact token/phase participation remains unspecified; dense topology, prototype component counts and Llama 3.1 backbone counts were not used to invent it. Preserved all 12 unrelated assessments. No weight shards or tensor census were used.
